events.title: GitHub Copilot app Customize tab is generally available
events.summary: GitHub Copilot is more useful when it works with the tools, knowledge, and workflows your team already relies on. The new Customize tab in the GitHub Copilot app brings MCP servers, plugins, skills, and canvases together in one place. Explore featured customizations, browse by type, and find new ways to tailor Copilot to how you and your team work.

events.title: Visual Studio Code 1.135
events.summary: Follow us on LinkedIn, X, Bluesky, Instagram Welcome to the 1.135 release of Visual Studio Code. This release helps you continue agent sessions across applications, get a second opinion on agent work, and understand chat usage while working in a more streamlined Agents window.
